sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 130. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Coercion Collapse (decreases all stats of the target by 30%, decreases the target's attack Ability accuracy by 20%, and reduces the target's HP recovery effects by 70%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Paralysis and Psychological Contamination Resistance Up by 50

[Forest Guardian] Lall or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
